answer: A payout is split so that 35% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The relic schedule is applied in ridge and beacon exposes each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 791 identities would post 3024 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
